description: The notables R-D-L2-004 produces from mac_table_sample.jsonlines. One, and the reason each other closed binding is not one.
predicate: sourcetype=binding:l2 AND bind_end_reason IN (conflict, displaced) AND bind_gap_ns <= 60000000000

not_notables.why: A legitimate move, not a spoof. The address left one port and was seen on another a whole poll cadence later, which is what a device that walked to a different desk looks like. The rule's gap threshold is 60 seconds and this is 300, so it is filtered out by the predicate rather than by a suppression list.
The stream ended while these bindings were open. Draining is not an observation about the network, so it is not one of the reasons the rule reads.
